lines.1: 「This looks entertaining, so I shall referee. Kanisawa will serve...」
lines.3: For once, Crab looked completely serious.
lines.4: 「...is what I shall say when it is time to begin.」
lines.6: Kinu ignored our teacher's joke and started the match.
lines.8: Crab opened with a fairly fast serve.
lines.10: Yashi snapped back a forceful return.
lines.16: Kinu's specialty of specialties: the "third-ball smash."
lines.17: Yashi tracked it with her eyes, but her body couldn't react.
lines.20: Inori's utterly listless call echoed through the room.
lines.21: 「Kanisawa is plainly a close-to-the-table attacker. The same as me.」
lines.22: 「Once she gets rolling, she's seriously tough.」
lines.23: 「We can't beat her, either. Guess having an empty head leaves room for amazing reflexes.」
lines.24: 「Come on, let's keep this moving! I'll load the next one with spin!」
lines.31: 「Ahaha! What's wrong? How strange. You were so confident, but now you're going to lose to the senior you mocked so much. Oh no!」
lines.32: 「Or what? Are you cooking up some grade-school excuse like being sore today?」
lines.35: 「Twelve to four. It appears I may be able to add another dish to dinner tonight.」
lines.36: 「All right! You're only a Coconut. I'll ship you to Greenland on the evening boat!」
lines.37: 「Do you even know where Greenland is?」
lines.38: 「Only the name. In Japanese it means Green Island, so it's somewhere south, right?」
lines.39: Everyone there stared at Crab in astonishment.
lines.40: How did this girl ever get into our school?
lines.41: 「Whoa, Yashi's having a seriously hard time.」
lines.42: 「If Nagomin is going to make her move, it'll be soon. Her table-tennis style is probably...」
lines.43: 「...I've got a pretty good read on the Crab's habits and thought process now.」
lines.44: 「What's that supposed to mean? Quit trying to sound cool, first-year!」
lines.48: 「So what if you chopped it? Drop dead!」
lines.49: Yashi chopped her next return, too.
lines.50: 「Quit dragging this out and drop dead already, you moron!」
lines.51: 「My, what remarkable language you use, Crabby.」
lines.52: 「She's used to being around guys... I've warned her over and over, but I gave up.」
lines.53: 「Tch, another damn push, you moron! Hrah!」
lines.56: 「You just don't know when to quit... Wh-Whoa, I used too much force.」
lines.57: Her overpowered smash sailed clear past the table.
lines.58: 「Tch... I put a little too much into it.」
lines.59: Crab still looked perfectly comfortable, giving an American-style shrug and an "oh well" pose.
lines.60: 「Here comes the next one! If all you're doing is pushing them back... I can serve you an easy one and still be just... fine!」
lines.62: Nagomi let the ball come in as close as possible...
lines.63: then drove a sharp backhand across the table.
lines.65: Crab returned it, but caught the net.
lines.67: The pace and spin on the ball had caught Crab too late.
lines.69: 「Fast attackers are formidable when they have momentum, but fall apart when their rhythm is broken... This match could go either way.」
lines.70: 「This is kind of surprising. I thought Yashi would play more aggressively.」
lines.71: 「No, this fits my image of her perfectly.」
lines.74: Yashi smiled as Crab grew increasingly irritated by the endless chops.
lines.75: She looked like a cold-blooded hunter enjoying the torment of her prey.
lines.76: 「She's mainly a chopper, but Nagomin has a good backhand loop.」
lines.77: 「She loops loose returns for points. She isn't just pushing--she's a chopper with sharp counterattacking fangs.」
lines.80: 「Um, I don't understand the table-tennis terms.」
lines.83: There it was: the jumping sky smash she had learned from manga.
lines.86: Yashi stopped the smash from far behind the table.
lines.87: 「She stopped that? Not bad. Crabby relies too much on her smash.」
lines.88: 「Kanisawa, draw Yashi closer to the table.」
lines.89: 「Hiyah! No advice from the peanut gallery, I say!」
lines.90: 「But if you let her stay back there, you are playing straight into her hands.」
lines.92: 「Sixteen to twenty. Kanisawa, show us the pride of a second-year or this will be pathetic. More importantly, my extra dinner dish...」
lines.93: 「D-Damn it! Me... one point from losing...? That can't happen. It can't happen!」
lines.94: She was spouting lines like a third-rate villain.
lines.96: 「...Heh. Ahahaha! Bring it on, Coconut. I'll show you what I'm like when I get serious.」
lines.97: 「N-No way. She can't be planning to use that!」
lines.98: 「What? Has she been saving some kind of finishing loop?」
lines.99: 「Stop! If you do that, you'll never...!」
